subject: bio
title: Nucleic Acids, Genes and Inheritance
subtitle: Nucleic Acids, Genes and Inheritance with mechanism-focused explanation and exam-linked examples.
concept: Genetics explains how biological information is stored, copied, and passed to offspring. DNA sequence provides coded instructions that influence protein structure and therefore phenotype.
The semi-conservative mechanism of replication preserves information accuracy by using each parental strand as a template for a new complementary strand.
Inheritance questions test probability and reasoning. Correct use of genetic notation and clear genotype-to-phenotype links are essential.
